What do you want to improve first?

This tool creates a plan on your device. It does not contact customers, publish anything or start a paid membership.

Your action plan

Choose one goal to build a plan.

Four practical steps

  1. Check your business name, location, category and website.
  2. Describe who you help, the services you provide, your process and how a new client should contact you.
  3. Create one useful general educational topic with the right professional limits.
  4. Track listing interest separately from consultations, clients and revenue.

Keep these rules in mind

  • Do not make unsupported expertise or superiority claims.
  • Follow any professional and advertising rules that apply to your field.
  • Do not guarantee clients, contracts or revenue.
